sources.snippet: It is the first open model in Destined AI's ClarityVoice family. This repository holds the inference code, examples, phone-mode notes and synthetic demo clips. The weights (3B parameters, 6.6 GB of safetensors) are on Hugging Face at destined/hurston-1.

sources.title: Destined AI Releases Hurston-1, an Open-Source Accented-English Text-to ...
sources.snippet: Destined AI Releases Hurston-1, an Open-Source Accented-English Text-to-Speech Model Built for the Phone Hurston-1 is an Apache-2.0 fine-tune of Maya1 that speaks Southern American and African English accents from a plain-language voice description — the first model in Destined AI's ClarityVoice family.

sources.title: Hurston-1: First Open TTS for Southern American and Afro-English ...
sources.snippet: Destined AI, an Atlanta-based startup, has released Hurston-1 on Hugging Face under an Apache 2.0 license.
